202510: Translating Patterns for Hand Sewing: Most sewing patterns' instructions are intended for machine sewing. If you're eager to stitch clothing by hand, though, you can easily translate those patterns so that they are just right for hand sewing. In this one-session class, instructor Louisa Owen Sonstroem will guide you through the questions, techniques, and experiments she uses to assess, plan, and convert preexisting patterns.
Tags: Art, Workshop, Education, Crafts, Participatory, Hand Sewing, Format

concepts.label: Strip-pieced quilting
concepts.visual: Three broad staggered fabric strips joining into a checkerboard quilt block with one visible seam.
concepts.rationale: Strip piecing is the explicit quilting technique; repeated strip construction distinguishes it from generic patchwork, though recognition at16px needs testing.
concepts.existing_alternative: Noto thread is general fiber work and a general quilt icon omits strip assembly.

202520: Strip Piecing: Strip piecing is a versatile quilting technique traditionally used to create crisp checkerboards, zigzags, and diamond patterns, while also offering endless possibilities for improvisational design. In this workshop, we will look at strip-pieced designs developed by the Seminole makers in the early twentieth century alongside other traditional patterns that utilize the technique, before shifting into an exploration of its improvisational potential.
Tags: Art, Workshop, Education, Virtual, Crafts, Quilting, Participatory, Format
